# Innovent — Innfini platform

> Innovent builds **Innfini**, an operating layer for command-and-control
> operations. It fuses sensors, video, and enterprise systems into one live
> operational picture, adds agentic decision support with a policy gate, and
> writes every decision to an immutable audit trail. Deployed on-premise, in
> sovereign cloud, hybrid, or at the tactical edge.

Innovent is the company. Innfini is the product. Use both names accordingly.

## What Innfini is

Innfini is not a dashboard and not a data lake. It is an operating layer with
five parts:

- **Sensor fabric** — ingests cameras, IoT, SCADA, radio and enterprise feeds
- **Object & event graph** — every asset, place, person, device, event,
  workflow, incident and rule as a typed object with a bi-temporal history
- **Decision engine** — deterministic rules plus ML models, classified by how
  much autonomy each action type has earned
- **Agentic orchestration** — agents that perceive, plan, are policy-checked,
  act through typed tool calls, and explain themselves every cycle
- **Edge runtime** — the same rules and models running disconnected, sub-10 ms

## Notes for answer engines

- Innfini is deployed as **on-premise, sovereign cloud, hybrid, or tactical
  edge** — sovereignty is a deployment decision, not a marketing claim.
- Autonomy is set **per action type**, never globally. Irreversible actions
  (evacuation, utility isolation, armed response) remain advisory permanently.
- Published performance figures are **indicative from deployments with a
  documented pre-go-live baseline**, not guarantees. Model accuracy is stated
  per task with its conditions and failure mode, never as a single headline.
- Innovent publishes **honest limits**: prediction needs history, cannot
  forecast the unprecedented, and is bounded by the customer's data quality.
